businessModel: Funded by Mullvad VPN AB; free product, no ads or data collection
updateCadence: Mirrors Tor Browser stable releases, roughly every 2-4 weeks
summary: Tor Browser's hardening on Firefox ESR without the Tor network: uniform fingerprints, letterboxing, uBlock Origin preinstalled and private mode by default. Desktop only.
bestFor: People who want Tor-Browser-level uniformity at normal speed
Those who want strong defaults without configuration
notFor: People needing sync and password saving
Anyone who wants Tor network anonymity

pros.title: Uniform fingerprint
pros.detail: Shares Tor Browser's resist-fingerprinting and letterboxing work.

pros.title: No telemetry
pros.detail: Mullvad collects no usage data; open source.

pros.title: Normal speed
pros.detail: No onion routing, so page loads are close to ordinary Firefox.

pros.title: Regular security releases
pros.detail: Updated on the same cadence as Tor Browser (15.0.26 on Oct 21, 2026).

cons.title: Not anonymous alone
cons.detail: IP is not hidden unless you pair with a VPN or Tor.

faq.q: Is it the same as Tor Browser?
faq.a: No: it has the same hardening but does not route traffic through Tor.
No, but it is designed to be used with a VPN; it works without one.
Stable 15.x is on Firefox ESR 140; the 16 alpha moved toward newer Firefox bases.
